text:
Aisha: Heads-up 024 renewal for HelioWorks hit a channel/payment wrinkle. They want to route payment through a reseller (ABC Solutions) and split the invoice between EU entity (70%) and US entity (30%). Also asking for our SOC2 report attached to the SOW. Need to lock pricing/term before legal sends to procurement.
Tom: Which term/seats are we talking about?
Aisha: 24mo renewal, seats 240 -> 300, enterprise discount 18% (as quoted). No change to feature package.
Rita (Billing): Reseller flow is fine but we need reseller vendor code RS-ABC-22 and two PO numbers (one for EU entity, one for US). Billing entity mapping: Redwood Inference EU Ltd for the EU invoice, Redwood Inc for US. Net30 applies by default.
Luis (Legal): For reseller routing we'll need the reseller channel addendum + explicit invoice split language in SOW. Also confirm: they want SOC2 (latest) attached and a data-retention clause tweak?
Aisha: Yes they requested SOC2 and confirmation of data retention 12 months.
Nikhil (SE): No Private/KMS requirement from HelioWorks. They plan Hosted + VPC peering. Deployment change not needed. Integration window ~3 business days for peering and route validation.
Rita (Billing): Example PO formats they should provide:```
EU PO: HW-EU-2026-77
US PO: HW-US-2026-88
```Please make sure PO numbers match vendor codes. I'll create two invoices and prorate the amounts.
Tom: Signatories? Who signs for HelioWorks and ABC?
Aisha: HelioWorks signatory is CEO Sofia Reyes, ABC signatory is Head of Procurement Mark Liu. Both requested DocSend preview before signing.
Luis (Legal): I'll draft the reseller addendum + invoice split clause and attach SOC2 cert. ETA tomorrow morning. Will cc @Rita for billing language.
compliance-bot: Reminder: Attaching SOC2 triggers internal disclosure workflow. Please add compliance review tag.
Aisha: Thanks all. I'll upload quote + draft SOW to DocSend and chase two PO numbers from HelioWorks. Will update thread when POs arrive :eyes:
